data.why: the repository ships no example micrographs (Models/.gitkeep and segmentation_results/ are both git-ignored placeholders), so a round-particle photo and a many-object fluorescence image stand in for SEM/TEM input to exercise segmentation, measurement, and PSD export

goals: load one or several grayscale SEM/TEM micrographs for analysis
apply CLAHE contrast enhancement and/or rebinning to improve segmentation quality on noisy or low-contrast input
run a segmentation model (YOLOv8n-seg, offline) to extract per-particle masks and bounding boxes
review the native-resolution mask overlay, particle crops, and per-particle measurement table before trusting the results
inspect particle size distributions (area, major/minor axis, equivalent diameter, Feret diameters) converted to nanometers using the pixel size
export per-image and combined CSVs or a full ZIP results package for downstream reporting

review.summary: The tree follows the README's SEM/TEM particle size workflow from loading through export, with good general/specific labels, screens that hold up on inspection, and well-cut features for preprocessing, inference, review, distributions and export. It needs a small fix before filing: it leaves out the pixel-size calibration step that every nm value depends on, includes a run-specific 'go back' task and a thin 'switch image' task, and counts a generic table toolbar as a feature.
